DDL	CREATE TABLE FLOAT4_TBL (f1  float) USING parquet

READ	SELECT float('nan')
READ	SELECT float('   NAN  ')
READ	SELECT float('infinity')
READ	SELECT float('          -INFINiTY   ')
READ	SELECT float('N A N')
READ	SELECT float('NaN x')
READ	SELECT float(' INFINITY    x')
READ	SELECT float('Infinity') + 100.0
READ	SELECT float('Infinity') / float('Infinity')
READ	SELECT float('nan') / float('nan')
READ	SELECT float(decimal('nan'))
READ	SELECT '' AS five, * FROM FLOAT4_TBL
READ	SELECT '' AS four, f.* FROM FLOAT4_TBL f WHERE f.f1 <> '1004.3'
READ	SELECT '' AS one, f.* FROM FLOAT4_TBL f WHERE f.f1 = '1004.3'
READ	SELECT '' AS three, f.* FROM FLOAT4_TBL f WHERE '1004.3' > f.f1
READ	SELECT '' AS three, f.* FROM FLOAT4_TBL f WHERE  f.f1 < '1004.3'
READ	SELECT '' AS four, f.* FROM FLOAT4_TBL f WHERE '1004.3' >= f.f1
READ	SELECT '' AS four, f.* FROM FLOAT4_TBL f WHERE  f.f1 <= '1004.3'
READ	SELECT '' AS three, f.f1, f.f1 * '-10' AS x FROM FLOAT4_TBL f
READ	SELECT '' AS three, f.f1, f.f1 + '-10' AS x FROM FLOAT4_TBL f
READ	SELECT '' AS three, f.f1, f.f1 / '-10' AS x FROM FLOAT4_TBL f
READ	SELECT '' AS three, f.f1, f.f1 - '-10' AS x FROM FLOAT4_TBL f
READ	SELECT '' AS five, * FROM FLOAT4_TBL
